# plan-structure

Validates that a plan, a GitHub Issue body under the `Plan` label, follows the [Plan issue template](../../../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/plan.md). It requires a one-line blockquote pitch, a `## Background` section, and a `## What needs to happen` section with at least one checklist item. No other `##` sections are allowed.

A repo's own `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE` file labeled `Plan` replaces the sections below. A section whose template shows a checklist item needs a checklist item.

Plans no longer live as repo files, so this check reads its target from stdin (or a `--body-file` path, `-` meaning stdin). It falls back to the runner's context-inline `--body` value. With no input at all it passes with zero files checked, so the file runner never trips on it. It is driven by the [issue-check workflow](../../../.github/workflows/README.md), not the local suite.

## Behavior

- Pass: a non-placeholder blockquote pitch before the first `##`, and a `## Background` section.
- Pass: a `## What needs to happen` section with a `- [ ]` or `- [x]` item, and no other `##` sections.
- Fail: a missing pitch, a placeholder pitch, a missing section, an empty checklist, or any extra `##` section — each its own error.
- Fail (pointed): an `## Open questions` section reports a message to turn unknowns into checklist steps instead.

Fenced code is skipped, so a `##` or checkbox inside a code sample never counts.
